# Vendored browser dependency

`livekit-client.umd.js` is the UMD browser build from
[`livekit-client@2.23.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/livekit-client/v/2.23.0),
downloaded from the npm package via jsDelivr:

<https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/livekit-client@2.23.0/dist/livekit-client.umd.js>

SHA-256:

```text
fb646f2260d84f91238d0a2dc10726c456631d6a26c7cafc43cfee5959b4d31d
```

It is vendored so the local UI loads without a CDN dependency. The LiveKit
JavaScript client is licensed under Apache-2.0; see
[`LIVEKIT_LICENSE`](LIVEKIT_LICENSE).
